_meta.title: Medicine domain graph — connectivity remediation (PROPOSAL ONLY)
_meta.purpose: Grounded feedback/reciprocal edges and redundant paths to remediate the findings from assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js (the audit module is domain-generic) run against assets/data/domains/medicine.json. This is a recommendation artifact; it does NOT modify any live graph.
_meta.discipline: Every proposed edge carries a concrete grounding (a canonical-nodes.json regulatory fact OR the reciprocity of an existing medicine.json edge). Candidates that could not be grounded are omitted and tallied under _omittedForLackOfGrounding.
_meta.doNotApply: Do not merge these edges into assets/data/domains/medicine.json without an explicit apply step.
_meta.neuroReferenceThesis: Healthy circuits are ~80% recurrent/lateral; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure (diaschisis). A pure feedforward tree is the broken/cosmetic version.
_meta.pathologyVerdict: SAME CORE SIGNATURE as Energy/Finance (near-total absence of feedback), with a DIFFERENT brittleness profile. (1) recurrentFraction = 0.032 — almost pure feedforward; the graph carries directed control rings but exactly ONE reciprocal PAIR exists (mPFC<->rACC = Primary Care <-> Medical Ethics, via TRANSFORMS + DEPENDS_ON), so unlike Finance/Energy (both 0) Medicine is marginally less tree-like but still far below the ~0.8 cortical benchmark. (2) UNLIKE Finance, Medicine is a SINGLE connected component at baseline (baseComponents = 1) — no pre-fractured dyad. (3) But Medicine is MORE internally brittle: 12 articulation nodes (Finance had 9) and a much deeper worst-case cut — removing THAL shatters the graph into 5 components (Finance's THAL was milder). The remediation therefore needs no reconnection of a disconnected component; it targets feedback density and the 12 single points of failure.

recurrenceAudit.note: Almost pure feedforward. The ONLY reciprocal pair is mPFC<->rACC (mPFC->rACC TRANSFORMS and rACC->mPFC DEPENDS_ON both present), giving reciprocalEdges = 2 and recurrentFraction 0.032 (Finance/Energy were exactly 0). The directed business-layer control ring (mPFC->M1->V1->HYPO->dlPFC->ECN->mPFC via CONTROLS/DEPENDS_ON) carries cycles but no other A->B with B->A. verdict from the module = 'has recurrent/lateral structure' only because lateralFractionOfClassifiable (0.382) clears the 0.2 lateral threshold; the feedback dimension is all but absent.

singlePointsOfFailure.baseComponentsNote: ONE component at baseline — the whole 41-node graph is connected (contrast Finance's 2 components / disconnected {M1,SMA} dyad). No reconnection of a severed component is required for Medicine.

mechanismOfEachArticulation.THAL: removal -> 5 components. Sole attachment of leaf S1 (THAL->S1), leaf CBLM (CBLM->THAL), the auditory relay island {A1, MGN} (THAL->A1 is A1's only link to the body), and the basal-ganglia island {GP, STRI} (GP->THAL is that island's only link out). The single worst point of failure in the graph.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.vmPFC: removal -> 3 components. Sole bridge of the reward/valuation cluster {OFC, NAcc, VTA, VP} to the main body — OFC->vmPFC is that cluster's ONLY link out — AND sole attachment of leaf PAG (vmPFC->PAG).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.NAcc: removal -> 3 components. Sole attachment of leaves VTA (VTA->NAcc) and VP (NAcc->VP).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.AI: removal -> 3 components. Sole attachment of leaves NTS (NTS->AI) and PI (PI->AI).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.dACC: removal -> 2 components. Sole bridge of the interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} to the main body — AI->dACC is that island's only link out.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.OFC: removal -> 2 components. Sole attachment of the {NAcc, VTA, VP} sub-cluster (NAcc->OFC is its only link to OFC).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.M1: removal -> 2 components. Sole attachment of leaf SMA (SMA->M1 is SMA's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.V1: removal -> 2 components. Sole attachment of leaf FEF (FEF->V1 is FEF's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.dlPFC: removal -> 2 components. Sole attachment of leaf FPN (FPN->dlPFC is FPN's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HIPP: removal -> 2 components. Sole attachment of leaf HPA (HPA->HIPP is HPA's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.A1: removal -> 2 components. Sole attachment of leaf MGN (MGN->A1 is MGN's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.GP: removal -> 2 components. Sole attachment of leaf STRI (STRI->GP is STRI's only edge).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the visual thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->V1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->V1 (excit, visual sensory relay). Layer-6 corticothalamic feedback (V1->LGN/pulvinar) is one of the most numerous projection classes in the brain and is functionally gain/precision control -> modul. canonical-nodes V1 = 'primary visual processing', THAL = motif M4 'gating relay / routing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the auditory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->A1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->A1 (excit, auditory sensory relay). A1->MGN corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory. canonical-nodes A1 = 'primary auditory processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the thalamo-cortico-thalamic somatosensory loop that THAL->S1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->S1 (excit, somatosensory relay). Layer-6 corticothalamic feedback S1->VPL is canonical and modulatory. canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the conflict-monitoring -> cognitive-control loop: the error/conflict signal feeds back to the executive to adjust control gain.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->dACC (excit). canonical-nodes dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control'; dACC<->dlPFC are reciprocally connected (Botvinick conflict-control loop).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience-network loop; the two salience hubs must be mutually coupled to co-select what gets escalated.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge AI->dACC (excit, 'interoceptive -> conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience', dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor'; the anterior insula and dorsal ACC are the two defining, reciprocally-coupled hubs of the salience network.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the value<->context loop; the context/valuation brake feeds back onto outcome valuation. Reciprocal of the existing OFC->vmPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge OFC->vmPFC (excit). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 'top-down inhibitory brake', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'; adjacent medial/orbital PFC regions with dense reciprocal connectivity.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the valuation<->reward loop; the outcome-valuation stage feeds forward-and-back to the reward driver. Reciprocal of the existing NAcc->OFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->OFC (excit). The orbitofrontal cortex is a principal glutamatergic corticostriatal input to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens (canonical OFC->NAcc projection). canonical-nodes OFC = M6 valuation, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the affective-appraisal loop: the threat/affect signal feeds back to the rostral-ACC regulator that already modulates it. Reciprocal of the existing rACC->BLA edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge rACC->BLA (modul, 'emotion modulates threat'). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition', rACC = 'rostral ACC — affective appraisal & regulation'; the basolateral amygdala and rostral/affective ACC are reciprocally connected in the emotion-appraisal circuit.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Gives the auditory cortex a cortical anchor off the THAL hub, reattaching the auditory relay island {A1, MGN} to the main body when THAL is removed. PARTIAL de-articulation: THAL still isolates leaf S1 and leaf CBLM (see _omittedForLackOfGrounding), so THAL remains a residual articulation point for those two dedicated relays.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; auditory cortex projects to the insular cortex (auditory-to-insula projection is documented; the insula integrates auditory salience).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HPA reaches the graph only via HPA->HIPP, so removing HIPP isolates it. Cortisol also acts on the amygdala, giving HPA a second, well-grounded anchor; removing HIPP then leaves HPA attached via BLA. Fully de-articulates HIPP.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Glucocorticoid (HPA-axis) output acts on the basolateral amygdala via glucocorticoid receptors, enhancing threat processing (textbook stress endocrinology). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks HPA as a COMPOSITE view (HYPO+PIT, 'not an edge endpoint'); the cleaner long-run fix is to remap HPA to a view rather than treat it as a node.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: VP reaches the graph only via NAcc->VP, so removing NAcc isolates it. The reward-loop closure edge VP->VTA gives VP a second anchor within the reward cluster. Doubles as recurrence: closes the mesolimbic reward loop VTA->NAcc->VP->VTA (the hedonic-output stage feeds back to regulate the dopamine source). Works together with VTA->mPFC (below) to fully de-articulate NAcc.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: In-graph the reward chain VTA->NAcc (excit) and NAcc->VP (inhib) already exists; the ventral pallidum sends GABAergic feedback to VTA (canonical mesolimbic disinhibition loop). canonical-nodes VP = 'ventral pallidum — reward/hedonic output', VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source'. One edge serves both recurrence and redundancy.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The whole reward/valuation cluster {OFC, NAcc, VTA, VP} reaches the main body ONLY via OFC->vmPFC, making vmPFC AND OFC AND NAcc single points of failure for it. A mesocortical dopamine projection VTA->mPFC gives the cluster a SECOND, independent bridge straight into a main-body hub (mPFC), de-articulating OFC and NAcc and (with the PAG fix below) vmPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source', mPFC = 'medial PFC — self-referential value integration (DMN core)'. The mesocortical dopamine projection from VTA to medial prefrontal cortex is a canonical pathway; mPFC is a degree-7 main-body hub in-graph.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PAG reaches the graph only via vmPFC->PAG, so removing vmPFC isolates it. A central-amygdala -> PAG efferent gives PAG a second afferent; removing vmPFC then leaves PAG attached via CeA. Together with VTA->mPFC (which reattaches the reward cluster), this fully de-articulates vmPFC. Also closes the threat-appraisal -> defensive-output pathway.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes CeA = M7 'phasic fear output', PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The central-amygdala -> periaqueductal-gray projection is the textbook fear-output pathway; CeA is already a main-body node in-graph.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} reaches the main body only via AI->dACC, so removing dACC isolates the whole island. An anterior-insula -> orbitofrontal edge gives the island a second bridge; removing dACC then leaves {AI, NTS, PI} attached via OFC. (Paired with the NTS->PVN and PI->dACC edges below, which also give the island's leaves independent anchors.)
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: The anterior insula projects to the orbitofrontal cortex, carrying interoceptive/gustatory signal into valuation (canonical insula->OFC pathway). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: AI splits into TWO leaves on removal: PI (PI->AI only) and NTS (NTS->AI only). This edge reattaches the PI leaf: a posterior-insula -> cingulate interoceptive edge gives PI a second anchor. Paired with NTS->PVN below, it fully de-articulates AI.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes PI = M10 'primary interoception', dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor' (salience hub). Posterior/mid-insula interoceptive signals project to the anterior cingulate as part of the interoception-salience pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches AI's second leaf, NTS (NTS->AI only). A visceral-afferent -> hypothalamus edge gives NTS a second anchor; removing AI then leaves NTS attached via PVN. Together with PI->dACC this drops AI from the articulation set.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes NTS = M10 'visceral afferent hub'. The nucleus tractus solitarius sends a canonical ascending projection to the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (visceral-afferent -> autonomic/neuroendocrine relay). PVN is already an in-graph node (target of BLA->PVN, HIPP->PVN, mPFC->PVN, LC->PVN; source of PVN->HYPO).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Single edge that de-articulates BOTH M1 and GP. SMA reaches the graph only via SMA->M1 (so M1 is its single point of failure) and STRI reaches the graph only via STRI->GP (so GP is its single point of failure). A corticostriatal SMA->STRI edge cross-links them: removing M1 now leaves SMA attached via SMA->STRI->GP->THAL->body; removing GP now leaves STRI attached via STRI<-SMA->M1->body.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes SMA = 'supplementary motor — self-initiated action sequencing'; SMA is a principal cortical source of the motor corticostriatal projection to putamen/striatum (canonical). canonical-nodes STRI = composite view (CAUD+PUT+NAcc); it is nonetheless an in-graph edge endpoint here (target of STRI->GP).

projectedImpact.method: The 17 proposed edges (8 feedback + 9 redundant) were appended to a deep copy of medicine.json in memory and re-scored with assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js. medicine.json itself was NOT modified.

reciprocalEdges.note: the 9 pairs are the 1 pre-existing mPFC<->rACC pair plus the 8 proposedFeedbackEdges (each the reverse of a pre-existing edge).

baseComponents.note: already a single component; no reconnection needed (contrast Finance 2->1).

articulationNodes.reason: All four residual articulation points survive solely because a dedicated sensory/relay/composite leaf has no second grounded projection target present in the graph, so its redundant path was omitted rather than fabricated: THAL still cuts off leaf S1 and leaf CBLM (removal -> 3 components); V1 still cuts off leaf FEF; dlPFC still cuts off leaf FPN (a composite view); A1 still cuts off leaf MGN. This is the same honest floor Energy/Finance bottomed out at (both remained articulate at V1/A1 for the identical LGN/MGN reason). 12 -> 4 is the grounded ceiling.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around THAL via a second edge on CBLM
candidates.reason: CBLM reaches the graph only via CBLM->THAL. The thalamus does not project to the cerebellum, and cerebellar cortical input arrives polysynaptically via the pontine nuclei (no direct cortex->CBLM fiber to any in-graph node). No honest second edge, so CBLM stays a leaf of THAL and THAL stays a residual articulation point for it. canonical-nodes CBLM = M6 'forward-model error-correct'.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around A1 via a second edge on MGN
candidates.reason: MGN is a dedicated cochlea-recipient (medial geniculate) auditory thalamic relay whose only cortical target is A1; no second grounded projection target exists among the graph's nodes. MGN stays a leaf of A1. canonical-nodes MGN = M4 'medial geniculate — auditory thalamic relay'.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around V1 via a second edge on FEF
candidates.reason: FEF reaches the graph only via FEF->V1 (top-down attention). The frontal eye fields' canonical efferents are the superior colliculus and oculomotor brainstem (not in-graph) and parietal/PFC attention areas; there is no clean, single grounded in-graph target to add without over-reaching. FEF stays a leaf of V1. canonical-nodes FEF = 'frontal eye fields — attentional gaze control'.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around dlPFC via a second edge on FPN
candidates.reason: FPN reaches the graph only via FPN->dlPFC. canonical-nodes marks FPN as a COMPOSITE view (dlPFC+IPS, 'not an edge endpoint or a firm'); adding a second edge to a composite would be modelling an aggregate as a node. The cleaner long-run fix is to remap FPN to a view rather than add an edge, so no edge is proposed and dlPFC stays a residual articulation point for it.

Hippocampal output to lateral PFC is not a monosynaptic projection; direct hippocampal-PFC fibers target mPFC/vmPFC, not dlPFC, and the mPFC relay is not on a medicine-graph edge path that would make the reciprocal honest. Cannot ground a direct HIPP->dlPFC edge (same omission Finance made).

_omittedForLackOfGrounding.notedButNotOmitted: A second anchor for THAL's S1 leaf (S1->M1, densely reciprocal somatomotor connectivity) IS groundable. It was NOT added because it would not clear THAL from the articulation set while the ungroundable CBLM leaf persists (THAL would still cut off CBLM). Recorded here as a groundable future edge, not an omission for lack of grounding.
